Both files score 100 with no findings. The margin/gap `0 0` in `.subtitle` uses shorthand with `0` values, which is allowed (0 is exempt from the px rule).

The screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`. There's a `Back to order` standalone `Link` with a leading arrow icon at the top, and a `Submit return` `Button` in the card footer that's disabled until every selected item has a reason, then shows a success `Alert`. Everything uses `@syntara/react` components and `var(--syntara-*)` tokens, logical CSS properties, and English copy (locale-agnostic since `ThemeScope` already handles `ar-AE` via `main.tsx`).

I can't run the app to visually verify per the instructions, so I haven't done a live browser check — the audit tool confirms token/API compliance, but layout/visual behavior is unverified.
